aliases: Proposed Spalding County data center campus
status_as_of_cutoff: Applications were formally withdrawn according to Spalding County's official public notice so the proposal could later be considered by the full Board with more public participation. The earlier reported approval is not treated as a verified vote or current approval; no construction or permit evidence was located.

actions.government_body: Spalding County Board of Commissioners (reported by specialist press)
actions.result_status: Specialist report said a $3.9 billion data center was approved for construction. The official approval packet, ordinance, vote tally, applicant identity, and permit were not located, so the reported claim is not treated as a verified vote.
actions.vote_tally: not published in official record located
actions.access_caveat: Press report only; later official county notice says the applications were withdrawn.
actions.evidence_note: Reported action contradicted/currently superseded by official withdrawal notice; no approval inferred.

actions.action_type: zoning / special exception / variance / future-land-use application withdrawal
actions.result_status: County public notice states the applicant formally withdrew its zoning, special-exception, variance, and future-land-use applications so the proposal could be considered by the full Board and receive additional public participation before possible resubmission.
actions.access_caveat: Notice does not identify the applicant or publish the withdrawn applications; resubmission was not verified by cutoff.
actions.evidence_note: Official withdrawal; not approval and not construction authorization.
